say:1:1160900001:1.text: Everyone thinks that Maulers only believe in raw power and strength. This is a misconception. I hope to bring more possibilities to the Ashen Wastes.
say:1:1160900001:1.source_cn: 所有人都会认为蛮血只崇尚破坏性强的纯粹力量，这其实是个...

say:2:1160900002:1.text: My father was a traveling merchant. I grew up following him and saw many weapons, scrolls, and accessories that contained power. While they have their advantages, they all pale in comparison to the magic charms.
say:2:1160900002:1.source_cn: 我的父亲是一名行脚商人，我从小跟着他见过很多蕴含力量的...

say:3:1160900003:1.text: Made from raw gems infused with magical power, the magic charms allow you to exert unanticipated power on the battlefield, assisting you in tapping into your own potential.
say:3:1160900003:1.source_cn: 魔饰由注入魔力的原石制成，可以让你在战场中发挥预料之外...

say:4:1160900004:1.text: I wanted to get them into the hands of all our glorious warriors, so I decided to become a magic charm merchant and bring them back to the Ashen Wastes.
say:4:1160900004:1.source_cn: 我希望它能到所有荣耀的战士手中，所以我决定做一名魔饰商...

say:5:1160900005:1.text: Take a look! Whether you want to build on your strengths or work on your weaknesses, I've got the magic charm for you!
say:5:1160900005:1.source_cn: 看看吧，无论是扬长还是避短，魔饰随意挑选！
